Environmental Impact Notice

Formal notification detailing projected ecological effects of vessel operations or construction works, issued for regulatory approval.

Questions and answers

Questions and answers

What is Environmental Impact Notice?

In this glossary, Environmental Impact Notice refers to: Formal notification detailing projected ecological effects of vessel operations or construction works, issued for regulatory approval.

How is Environmental Impact Notice used in maritime?

In maritime communication, this term appears in contexts such as: "Port authority to dredging contractor: environmental impact notice for capital dredge must be submitted with turbidity modelling and mitigation plan before permit issuance, acknowledge, over."

Why does Environmental Impact Notice matter in maritime?

Environmental Impact Notice matters because it supports clear communication in Meteorology contexts for Deck Officers, Engine Officers, and Masters. It also connects to aviation training and exam language such as STCW, Marlins Test, ISF Watchkeeper, and GMDSS.

Who uses Environmental Impact Notice?

Environmental Impact Notice is mainly used by Deck Officers, Engine Officers, and Masters.

What category does Environmental Impact Notice belong to?

In this glossary, Environmental Impact Notice is grouped under Meteorology. Related pages in this category explain adjacent procedures, commands and operational concepts.

Where does this definition come from?

This definition is sourced from IMO SMCP, STCW Convention, SOLAS, COLREG and published by Protermify Maritime as a static maritime reference page.

Definition

Formal notification detailing projected ecological effects of vessel operations or construction works, issued for regulatory approval.

Operational example

Port authority to dredging contractor: environmental impact notice for capital dredge must be submitted with turbidity modelling and mitigation plan before permit issuance, acknowledge, over.
